$comment: Facts each package must contribute to the resolved deployment graph.
These replace source-text substring pins in the *authority* scripts, which
matched how a module was written rather than what it contributes.
Every declared graph action id must be qualified by its own package, as
'<packageName>#...'. This is an authoring convention, not a wire contract:
actionPolicy.id stays an opaque lookup key and a consumer must not infer
ownership from its shape. See voyant#4596, where two shapes for one field
invited exactly that inference. Add to 'allow' only with the reason an id
cannot move; a stale entry fails the check.
